avis.titre: Not worth the hype — AVOID IF ACNE PRONE!
avis.texte: I was excited to try this. It had been hyped up online, however after many attempts, I was left with worse skin than before. I have acne prone skin, and I was told this could be beneficial. The first few times I tried it, I had difficulty with it peeling off during the night. I never saw beneficial results within the first few attempts, but I gave it a few more tries to allow time to see. Every time I've tried using this it leaves a greasy, almost sticky, feeling even after hours of drying. It's weird and uncomfortable to sleep in. I started to notice acne popping up after utilizing this. Some of what popped up was just small, typical looking zits, or closed comedones. But then I noticed deep seeded, almost cystic acne, popping up. The acne I was getting from this product has been a nightmare to clear up. Deep seeded cysts that take weeks to heal, and seem to come back even after clearing. Never had issues like this till I used this product… AVOID IF ACNE PRONE!! Love medicube, and this has been my only flop from them, but it wont stop me from using their other products, not everything is acne safe and I understand that. I just want to spread this to help other acne prone people out there.
Makes my face smooth/soft and gives it a nice refreshed glow!
